_comment: Activities the avatar can do. Each activity has options; each option has a duration in avatar hours (or "slider" for sleep), effects per avatar hour on GameState values, a background colour and an animation name. Effects only count for the time actually done. Options marked "placeholder": true use temporary numbers.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.comment: Duration comes from the sleep slider (config.json: sleep_activity, time.max_sleep_hours). Sleep measure +0.07 per hour slept (10 h restores 0.7).

cardio.name: Cardio
cardio.comment: calories_spent is in kcal per avatar hour. Cardio spends more calories than muscle strength.

strength.name: Muscle strength
strength.comment: Muscle strength raises muscle more than cardio. There is no fatigue system.
